candidate_workaround: Pass fixed directories to ripgrep and express filename selection with one or more -g filters on Windows.
failure_signature: Ripgrep rejected wildcard positional path arguments that PowerShell had not expanded.
recurrence_guard: Use positional directory roots plus ripgrep glob filters instead of wildcard positional paths.
rollback: Retain the refused scan at zero credit and do not infer absence until the corrected directory-scoped scan passes.
scope_boundary: Read-only Windows ripgrep file selection only.
title: Use ripgrep glob filters for Windows filename selection
trigger_preconditions: A Windows ripgrep scan must select filename families across fixed repository directories.
